package org.aetheris.swing
  • Class
    Description
    AetherisNotebookPanel
    The AetherisNotebookPanel is the notebook surface on tab B.
    AetherisNotebookPanel.Host
    The Host is the application side this panel calls.
    AetherisStage2
    The AetherisStage2 class holds the notebook rules the canvas shares.
    AetherisWorker
    The AetherisWorker class is the single background thread the shell uses for database work and AMWP client reads.
    GrokSettingsDocument
    The GrokSettingsDocument class reads and writes aetheris-grok.yaml.
    Incrementor
    The Incrementor class is a row-count control with minus, a text field, and plus.
    Incrementor.Listener
    The Listener interface receives a row count after it changes.
    SoftWrapArea
    The SoftWrapArea class is a text area that wraps at a character column while soft wrap is on.
    ThinkPaneManager
    The ThinkPaneManager class is the gateway to a thinking pane.
    ThinkStream
    The ThinkStream class writes a thinking chunk to one pane.
    ThinkStrip
    The ThinkStrip class is the thinking pane.
    ThinkStrip.Host
    The Host interface holds the facts the strip does not own.
    ViewBounds
    The ViewBounds class reads and writes the View dialog rectangle for one vault user.
